{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99')
filtered_df = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
filtered_df['revenue'] = filtered_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")"}
